messages:
rachel: Noticed an odd p99 bump on the endpoint breakdown view after we toggled 'show per-route' yesterday. p50 unchanged, p99 up ~450ms for a subroute. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/route-bump
 tim: Are we showing per-route percentiles by default or an aggregated merge? I thought we changed that to merged-to-avoid-noise.
 aya: Console currently shows per-route lines by default when multiple routes exist. That revealed a tiny subroute with very few samples that dominates the visible p99.
 sre-nick: Pulled raw samples from telemetry for the suspect subroute:
```
window: 2026-02-14T10:12Z
endpoint: /v1/respond (route=sub-A)
sample_count: 7
latencies_ms: [30,32,33,35,36,330,340]
```
 aya: With n=7 p99 is basically the 2nd or 3rd highest value; visualizing it as the main line without provenance is misleading.
 product-zoe: UX idea: default to showing a single merged percentile row labeled "endpoint (merged)" with a disclosure chevron to expand per-route lines. When expanded, show a small provenance pill per line: "empirical (n=7)" or "sketch(qs=120)".
 tim: I like that. Also add a lightweight "variance spotlight" that automatically flags any subroute where the per-route p99 > merged p99 by > 2x and n < 50.
 aya: Implementation note: merged percentile can be computed server-side by merging tdigest sketches when available; if some routes are empirical-only, merge fallback histograms and mark provenance = "merged:mixed". UI should show that string.
 sre-nick: Alerting change: suppress p99-based alerts triggered by small subroutes. Alerts should evaluate on merged percentile unless an SLO is explicitly variant-scoped. We'll gate on sample_count >= 30 for per-route alerts.
 telemetry-bot: telemetry metadata we already emit: {"tdigest_qs":"qs","raw_count":"n","hist_fallback":"bool"}. We'll extend to expose a compact provenance token: e.g., "prov=emp:n=7" or "prov=td:qs=120". UI maps tokens to friendly text.
 product-zoe: Copy for pill: "Empirical (n=7) - unreliable percentile" and tooltip: "Percentile estimated from raw samples; small sample sizes may produce noisy estimates. Click to view raw distribution."
 tim: For smoothing we should avoid carrying forward a subroute's old stats when the route becomes tiny after a routing change. Proposal: if current_window_n < 50 and previous_window_n == 0, force smoothing_reset for that subroute for 2 buckets.
 aya: Also add a console toggle: 'Prefer merged percentiles when expanding low-volume splits' so product teams can pick their default.
 product-zoe: I'll update the rollout docs with guidance: prefer merged percentiles for overall health, use per-route lines for debugging, and prefer median SLOs for low-volume routes.
 aya: I'll spin up ENG-PLAT-1888 to implement the provenance pill + merged-default; will post design in #eng-platform.
 telemetry-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-1888 assigned to aya, tim, due 2026-03-01.
